name: Kentucky

agency.name: Kentucky Energy and Environment Cabinet, Department for Natural Resources, Division of Oil and Gas (Kentucky Geological Survey keeps the public well database)

form.name: Application for Permit (OG-1), rev 06/19, 5 pages with attachment pages for mineral and surface owners
form.notes: Read all 22 items (pdftotext on the fillable PDF). Curl got 403 from eec.ky.gov; the PDF came through WebFetch (not retried). Notarized; $350 fee; one original and two copies of the well location plat. Items: drill/deepen/reopen, operator, mineral owner, county, Carter coordinates, elevation, deepest formation and max TVD, USGS quad, well type A-H, coal strata notice, gas storage buffer, surface owner and notice, mud system, coal bond land, pooling, twin well, horizontal/deviated endpoint and measured depth, entity type. No casing, cement, BOP, H2S, water or frac items on this form.

api_number.n: API # in weekly list; API (14 digits) in KGS shapefile

permit_number.n: PERMIT # in weekly list; KGS_Permit in shapefile

lease_name.n: LEASE NAME in weekly list; OG-1 asks farm/lease only as mineral owner (item 5)

operator_name.n: COMPANY NAME in weekly list; OG-1 item 2 (must match bond name)

operator_id.n: OG-1 asks the operator name only; no operator number

operator_type.n: OG-1 item 21: type of entity and state of registration

bond.n: OG-1 item 2: applicant must match name on bond; BOND box for office use

county.n: COUNTY in weekly list and shapefile

district.n: No district on OG-1 or in the lists

field_pool.n: OG-1 asks formation (item 9), not field or pool

surface_latlon.n: Latitude and Longitude (NAD 27) in weekly list; Lat/Lng 27 and 83 in shapefile

surface_plss.n: Carter coordinate (section, letter, number) and footages; Kentucky is not PLSS

bottom_hole_loc.n: OG-1 item 20: endpoint of wellbore if horizontal or deviated

lateral_path.n: KGS permitted deviated traces and inflection points since 2006 (weekly)

elevation.n: ELEVATION in weekly list; Surf_Elev in shapefile; OG-1 item 8

surface_owner.n: OG-1 items 14 and 15: surface owner and notice of intent to drill

well_type.n: PURPOSE in weekly list (OG-1 item 11: oil, gas, storage, water, CBM, EOR, strat, obs)

work_type.n: PERMIT FOR in weekly list (OG-1 item 1: drill, deepen, reopen); only 'Drilling' seen

well_direction.n: SLANT and MULTILATERAL in weekly list; OG-1 item 20

proposed_depth_md.n: OG-1 item 20: proposed total measured depth, horizontal or deviated only

proposed_depth_tvd.n: PROJECTED DEPTH in weekly list; OG-1 item 9 is max true vertical depth (inferred)

target_formation.n: FORMATION in weekly list; OG-1 item 9 deepest formation to be tested

pit_waste.n: OG-1 item 16 only asks whether a mud system is used (water loss 10 cc)

frac_dates.n: High-volume horizontal wells file the treatment date at FracFocus; the OG-3 completion form shows drilling dates only

frac_chemicals.n: High-volume horizontal wells file chemicals and CAS numbers at FracFocus; OG-3 asks for a copy attached

frac_additives.n: Registry form is required for high-volume horizontal wells; OG-3 asks for a copy; the agency's data lists no products

frac_amounts.n: Required through FracFocus: maximum percent by mass of each chemical; OG-3 itself asks only for total volumes

spacing_unit.n: OG-1 item 18: pooled or unitized well, and the authority

spacing_exception.n: No exception request on OG-1 (item 19 asks only about a twin well)

mineral_owner.n: OG-1 item 5: mineral owner (lessor), with lease expiration date

fee.n: $350.00 stated on OG-1; FEE box for office use

notice_hearing.n: OG-1 items 12, 13, 15: certified-mail notice to coal owners, storage owners, surface owner

date_received.n: Not in lists; OG-1 has a RECORD NO box for office use only

date_approved.n: DATE ISSUED in weekly list (Excel serial date); date_permit_issued in deviated layer

date_expires.n: Not on OG-1 (item 6 is the lease expiration, not the permit)

spud_date.n: No spud field in weekly list or KGS shapefile

completion_date.n: Cmpl_Date in KGS shapefile (blank for new permits)

status.n: Org_Result (LOC = location only), Plug_Date in shapefile; approved flag in deviated layer

plat_image.n: OG-1 foot: original and two copies of the well location plat; online copy unverified

logs.n: Elog, Core, Cuttings flags in KGS shapefile (flags only)

grade_reason: The weekly Excel permit lists are per permit with DATE ISSUED, work type, well type, depth, formation and location: A-quality content, free, no login, current to 2026-10-23, history back to 2017. But the host eec.ky.gov answered this machine's one curl request with 403 (the files only came through WebFetch), and the lists are one file per week (about 52 a year). The reachable KGS shapefile has no issue date (completion date only). Upgrade to A if a GitHub runner can fetch the xlsx files.
producer_plan: Download each 'Permit List for Week Ending YYYY-MM-DD.xlsx' (current page, then the archive page for 2017-2025; .xls before 2022-08-19 needs a different reader), read Sheet1, keep rows with a numeric PERMIT #, turn DATE ISSUED (Excel serial) into a date, and count permits per month, split by PERMIT FOR (work type: drilling; OG-1 also allows deepen and reopen) and PURPOSE (well type). SLANT and MULTILATERAL separate vertical from horizontal; FORMATION, PROJECTED DEPTH, ELEVATION and Latitude/Longitude (NAD27, some values carry stray tab or space characters) are in the same row; the county comes with the row. Sanity check: a few rows per week (2 on the latest), so monthly counts are small and a missing week shows as a hole. Cross-check permit numbers (113697 and 113698 issued 2026-10-22) against the KGS shapefile's KGS_Permit, where new permits show as Org_Result LOC a week or more later. Test the host from the real runner first (one request, default user agent); the 403 seen here may be a front-door rule. Do not publish the ADDRESS, CITY, STATE and ZIP columns or lease names.
privacy_notes: Weekly lists carry the applicant's mailing address columns and lease names that are often a landowner's name (e.g. 'farm of <person>'); OG-1 also holds mineral and surface owner addresses, phones and e-mails (not published). Operators can be sole proprietors (OG-1 item 21), so any build needs a corporate-name filter. None copied here.
